card.name: Before or when opening a precaution clause
card.fires_on: The word Before (or when) that starts a precaution sentence in drug warnings, often right after a reported-reaction sentence. It also fires on when/before inside advice such as choosing a dose or operating machinery.

modes.label: Sentence-initial Before
modes.description: Capitalized Before opens a new sentence about what to do prior to starting therapy.
modes.example: [see Adverse Reactions ( 6.2 )] .<< Before>> initiating dextroamphetamine saccharate

modes.label: Mid-sentence when/before
modes.description: Lowercase when or before introduces a condition inside a warning or instruction.

modes.label: Other future-intent words
modes.description: Occasional will or shall in non-drug text that introduces a planned action.
modes.example: 5.8 Over time, the Government<< will>> aim to reform the tax system

card.plain: It fires on words like Before or When that begin a precaution, such as before starting a drug or when doing something.
